summary: Something drawn in the world for chosen players, a decal, cylinder, sphere, chevron, cube or plane, which can also report players walking in and out. The server stores each marker and tells each player's game when to show, change or remove it.

place.summary: Places a marker and returns it.

params.material: The decal material, 1 to 256 characters; see Marker.list.
params.options: `shape`, 'decal' (default), 'cylinder', 'sphere', 'chevron', 'cube' or 'plane'; `rotation`; `size`, 0.25 to 64, default 2; `height`, 0.25 to 64, default 2; `spin`, degrees per second, -720 to 720; `bob`, 0 to 4; `color`, 0xRRGGBBAA; `trigger: true` fires markerEnter and markerExit.

place.exampleLua:
local Events, Chat = kcds.core.Events, kcds.core.Chat

local ring = kcds.world.Marker.place("materials/decals/ring", kcds.math.Vector3.new(100, 200, 10), { shape = "cylinder", size = 3, color = 0x00ff00ff, trigger = true })

Events.on("markerEnter", function(marker, player)
  if marker.id == ring.id then
    Chat.sendToAll(player.nickname .. " stepped in")
  end
end)

all.summary: All markers, or those in one dimension.

params.dimension: Optional: limits it to this dimension.

getById.summary: The marker with this network id, or null.

removeAll.summary: Removes all markers, or those in one dimension, and returns how many.

params.dimension: Optional: limits it to this dimension.

exists.exampleLua:
if not marker.exists then
  print("removed")
end

material.summary: The decal material it was placed with.

group.summary: The family its material belongs to.

size.summary: Its width in metres, 0.25 to 64. You can assign to it.

height.summary: Its height in metres, 0.25 to 64. You can assign to it.

spin.summary: Its turning speed in degrees per second, -720 to 720. You can assign to it.

bob.summary: How far it moves up and down, 0 to 4. You can assign to it.

color.summary: Its colour as 0xRRGGBBAA. You can assign to it.

trigger.summary: Whether it fires markerEnter and markerExit. The volume is an upright cylinder as wide as the marker, from 1 m below it to its height, or to 2 m for a decal or plane. You can assign to it.

rotation.summary: Its rotation. You can assign to it.
rotation.exampleCs:
// the same Euler angles in degrees JavaScript passes
marker.AsValue().Set("rotation", new { z = 45 });

dimension.summary: Its dimension. Change it with setDimension.

setDimension.summary: Moves the marker to another dimension.

destroy.summary: Removes the marker, firing markerRemove. Players inside get no markerExit.

params.prefix: Optional: limits it to decals whose path starts with this.

showOnlyTo.summary: Limits who sees it, to a player or list of players. null shows it to everyone again.

remove.summary: Removes the marker, firing markerRemove first.
